blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines —The Benedicto College (BC) Cheetahs made a strong statement in the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) Season 26, crediting their tough defense for a huge 64-55 upset win over the four-peat defending champions, University of the Visayas (UV) Green Lancers, to close out the first round of the eliminations on top of the team standings on Thursday, October 8, at the Cebu Coliseum. The Cheetahs finished the first round with an impressive 7-1 win-loss record, handing UV its second loss in eight games and dropping the Green Lancers to second place in the standings.
